page.layout: One block of text: a list of treatise titles in one column, running down the page, with the printed page number at top right. No margin notes. Signature at lower right.

main_text.l: De Peregrinationibus religionis ergô, & locis Sacris.

page.notes: The faint text showing through the lower half of the page is show-through from the reverse side and is left out. The page number "5" is printed at the upper right, above the first line. The "A 5" signature is printed at the foot. Ligatures and abbreviations are kept as printed: "ergô", "Defunctorû", "exe-quijs" split across lines with the hyphen at "exe‐" rendered as printed. Long s is written as plain s.
